name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefit: ₹6,000 per year direct income support in 3 installments of ₹2,000 each
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Provides direct income support to all landholding farmer families across India to supplement their financial needs for procuring inputs and other needs related to agriculture.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Crop insurance covering up to full sum insured. Premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for Horticulture
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and diseases. The government pays the balance premium.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Short-term credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest (after government interest subvention). Working capital for agriculture, fisheries, and animal husbandry.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare / RBI
description: Provides timely and adequate credit support to farmers for their cultivation needs, post-harvest expenses, maintenance of farm assets, allied activities, and consumption requirements.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free soil testing and health card every 2 years. Guidance on correct fertilizer usage to reduce input costs by 8-10%.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Provides every farmer a Soil Health Card with information on soil nutrient status and fertilizer recommendations for 12 nutrients, helping optimize fertilizer use.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) – Per Drop More Crop
benefit: 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers on drip and sprinkler irrigation equipment.
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti / Ministry of Agriculture
description: Aims to expand irrigation coverage and improve water use efficiency through drip and sprinkler systems under the motto 'Har Khet Ko Pani, More Crop Per Drop'.

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAFTAAR)
benefit: Grants and loans for agriculture infrastructure, food processing, and agri-startups. Seed capital up to ₹25 lakh for agri-entrepreneurs.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Holistic development of agriculture and allied sectors to ensure remunerative returns to farmers through development of infrastructure and promotion of agri-entrepreneurship.

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
benefit: Subsidy 40-50% for establishing orchards, 50% for cold chain, 50% for post-harvest management. Maximum assistance ₹12,000-50,000 per hectare depending on crop.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Promotes holistic growth of horticulture sector including fruits, vegetables, root and tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, flowers, aromatics, coconut, cashew, and bamboo.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
benefit: Subsidized certified seeds, micronutrients, soil amendments, farm machinery, and training. Up to 50% subsidy on inputs.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Aims to increase production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals, and commercial crops to ensure food security through area expansion and productivity enhancement.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market) Registration
benefit: Access to pan-India online trading platform for better price discovery. Direct sale without middlemen. Free registration.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: A pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities, providing better price discovery.

name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana
benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60. Government contributes equal amount to farmer's contribution of ₹55-200/month based on age.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers aged 18-40 years. Ensures financial security to farmers in their old age.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
benefit: 40-50% subsidy (up to ₹1.2 lakh) on agricultural machinery including tractors, power tillers, harvesters, seed drills, and sprayers for small/marginal farmers.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Promotes farm mechanization by making agricultural equipment affordable for small and marginal farmers through subsidies and establishing Custom Hiring Centres (CHC).

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) – Organic Farming
benefit: ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for cluster-based organic farming. Includes certification costs, inputs, and market linkage support.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Promotes organic farming through adoption of organic village clusters. Provides financial assistance for organic inputs, certification, and market development.

name: Neem Coated Urea Scheme
benefit: 100% of urea is neem coated at subsidized rates. Reduces urea consumption by 7-10%, increases soil fertility, and reduces pest/disease incidence.
ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
description: All domestically manufactured urea is mandatorily neem-coated to slow release of nitrogen, improve nitrogen use efficiency, and reduce diversion of urea for non-agricultural use.

name: Direct Benefit Transfer for Fertilizer Subsidy
benefit: Fertilizer subsidy of ₹500-5,000+ per bag transferred directly. No black market diversion. Real-time tracking.
ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
description: Point-of-sale devices at fertilizer shops authenticate purchases via Aadhaar, ensuring fertilizer subsidy reaches actual farmers without leakage.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
benefit: Loans up to ₹2 crore at 3% interest subsidy for 7 years. For post-harvest management, cold chains, warehouses, and primary processing units.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: ₹1 lakh crore financing facility for investment in post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets through interest subvention and financial support.

name: Magel Tyala Shet Tale (Maharashtra) – Farm Pond Scheme
benefit: 100% subsidy on farm pond construction (5m×4m×3m) plus plastic lining. Value up to ₹75,000 per beneficiary.
ministry: Government of Maharashtra – Agriculture Department
description: Provides farm ponds to every farmer who applies in Maharashtra to store rainwater for supplemental irrigation. Especially beneficial for drought-prone Vidarbha and Marathwada regions.

name: Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project (Maharashtra)
benefit: ₹4,000 crore World Bank aided project. Financial support for climate-resilient agriculture, water management, and soil health. Per-farm support up to ₹2 lakh.
ministry: Government of Maharashtra
description: Transforming rain-fed agricultural areas in Maharashtra into climate-resilient zones. Focuses on sustainable agriculture practices, soil health, and water conservation.

name: UP Kisan Mitra Urja Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
benefit: Free electricity up to 1000 units per month for agricultural connections. Annual power subsidy benefit of ₹12,000 per farmer.
ministry: Government of Uttar Pradesh
description: Provides free electricity to farm pump connections in Uttar Pradesh to reduce irrigation costs for small and marginal farmers.

name: UP Sinchai Pump Subsidy (Uttar Pradesh)
benefit: 90% subsidy on submersible/electric pump sets for SC/ST farmers, 50% for others. Maximum benefit ₹10,000.
ministry: Government of Uttar Pradesh – Minor Irrigation
description: Provides subsidized pump sets for irrigation to small and marginal farmers in Uttar Pradesh to increase the area under assured irrigation.

name: Punjab Agriculture Pump Set Scheme
benefit: Free 7.5 HP submersible pump set for SC farmers. 50% subsidy for other farmers. Saves ₹25,000-60,000 in pump costs.
ministry: Government of Punjab – Agriculture Department
description: Provides subsidized/free pump sets to farmers for efficient irrigation. Special focus on uplifting SC farming families.

name: Punjab Crop Residue Management Scheme
benefit: ₹2,500 per acre incentive for in-situ crop residue management (not burning). Equipment subsidy 50-80% for Happy Seeder, Super SMS, Rotavator.
ministry: Government of Punjab
description: Promotes crop residue management to stop paddy straw burning, reduce air pollution, and improve soil organic carbon in Punjab.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Hasirudhama Scheme (Karnataka) – Vermicompost
benefit: 75% subsidy for establishing vermicompost units (up to ₹15,000). Support for organic certification under PGS India.
ministry: Government of Karnataka – Horticulture Department
description: Promotes organic farming through vermicomposting, bio-fertilizers, and natural pest management in Karnataka to reduce chemical input costs.

name: Karnataka Drip Irrigation Scheme (Under PMKSY)
benefit: 90% subsidy for SC/ST small/marginal farmers, 75% for others, on drip and sprinkler irrigation. Maximum ₹1.25 lakh per hectare.
ministry: Government of Karnataka – Agriculture Department
description: Karnataka's implementation of PMKSY with enhanced subsidies. Rapid adoption of micro-irrigation across all agro-climatic zones in Karnataka.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Jeevan Kalyan Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
benefit: ₹4 lakh compensation on accidental death, ₹2 lakh for permanent disability, ₹25,000 for daughter's marriage. Zero premium for farmers.
ministry: Government of Madhya Pradesh
description: Comprehensive insurance and social security scheme for registered farmers in Madhya Pradesh providing financial protection against accidents, disability, and family events.

name: MP Beej Gram Yojana (Madhya Pradesh Seed Village)
benefit: 50-100% subsidy on certified seeds of wheat, rice, maize, soybean, and pulses. Villages designated as seed production centers get premium prices.
ministry: Government of Madhya Pradesh – Agriculture Department
description: Promotes production of quality certified seeds at village level in Madhya Pradesh, improving seed replacement rate and ensuring availability of quality planting material.

name: Agricultural Technology Management Agency (ATMA)
benefit: Free training, demonstrations, farmer field schools, and exposure visits. Technology adoption support up to ₹10,000 per farmer per year.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Bottom-up participatory approach for agricultural extension. Provides training, demonstrations, and technology dissemination through Farmer Interest Groups (FIGs) and FPOs.

name: Negotiable Warehouse Receipt (NWR) System – WDRA
benefit: Pledge loans against warehouse receipts at 70-80% of commodity value. Avoids distress sale. 6% interest loan from banks.
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs / WDRA
description: Allows farmers to store produce in registered warehouses and obtain loans against warehouse receipts, avoiding distress sales at harvest when prices are low.

name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 FPOs
benefit: ₹15 lakh grant per FPO over 5 years. Management cost support, equity grant up to ₹15 lakh, credit guarantee up to ₹2 crore.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
description: Promotes Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs) to aggregate small farmers, achieve economies of scale in input procurement, processing, value addition, and marketing.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana for Farmers
benefit: ₹2 lakh life insurance at just ₹436/year premium. Auto-renews. Covers death from any cause.
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Insurance Regulatory Authority
description: Life insurance scheme providing ₹2 lakh cover to farmers and all citizens aged 18-50 years at extremely affordable premium, protecting farm families against loss of breadwinner.

name: PM-KUSUM (Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
benefit: 90% subsidy on solar pump installation (₹3 lakh+ pump at ₹0.30-0.50 lakh for farmer). Option to sell surplus solar power to grid at ₹3.14/unit.
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Provides solar-powered pump sets to reduce dependence on diesel/grid power, lower irrigation costs by 80-90%, and generate additional income through grid-connected solar plants.
